summary: Configured and verified the four-node distributed MinIO service. All 4 nodes/drives are online with EC:2, authenticated TLS works on the 10.64.0.0/24 network, and infra-data/proof.txt contains the requested content. Credentials are stored at /root/minio-admin.env on node1 without disclosure.
actions_performed: Configured persistent storage and systemd startup on node1-node4
Generated a common CA and validated per-node TLS identities
Bound MinIO to storage IPs and restricted access with UFW
Installed mc on node1 and verified authenticated access
Created and verified the requested bucket and object
